activities.title: Welcome Back: What Inspired This Look?
activities.summary: Students use one opener board to choose a likely inspiration source and two visible design clues before the week moves into fuller rationale language.

en.title: Welcome Back: What Inspired This Look?
en.summary: Look at one design board and choose the best inspiration clues.
en.instructions: Look at the opener board. Choose the most likely inspiration source and the best visible clues. Complete all three quick selections.
success_criteria: I can notice one likely inspiration source.
I can choose visible clues from the board.
I can prepare for this week's design-rationale work.

pt.title: Bem-vindo de volta: o que inspirou este look?
pt.summary: Observe um painel de design e escolha as melhores pistas de inspiracao.
pt.instructions: Observe o painel inicial. Escolha a fonte de inspiracao mais provavel e as melhores pistas visiveis. Complete as tres selecoes rapidas.
success_criteria: Eu consigo perceber uma fonte de inspiracao provavel.
Eu consigo escolher pistas visiveis no painel.
Eu consigo me preparar para o trabalho de justificativa de design desta semana.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the opener short and controlled. The visible clue questions should rely only on obvious design details from the board.
materials: Week 12 opener board with one look and several inspiration thumbnails

input.prompt_en: Choose the best inspiration source and visible clues from the opener board.
input.prompt_pt: Escolha a melhor fonte de inspiracao e as pistas visiveis no painel inicial.

items.label_en: What is the most likely inspiration source for this look?
items.label_pt: Qual e a fonte de inspiracao mais provavel para este look?

items.label_en: Which visible clue supports your answer best?
items.label_pt: Qual pista visivel apoia melhor a sua resposta?

items.label_en: Which mood fits the look best?
items.label_pt: Qual clima combina melhor com o look?

steps.title: Look at the board
steps.student_action_en: Study the main look and the inspiration thumbnails.
steps.student_action_pt: Observe o look principal e as miniaturas de inspiracao.

steps.student_action_en: Complete the three short selections.

challenge: Ask stronger learners to say one full sentence after the three selections.

activities.teacher_instructions: Keep the texts short, A2-readable, and perfectly aligned to the reusable gallery image A to image D.
materials: Week 12 reusable inspiration gallery image A to image D

input.prompt_en: Read the four short inspiration notes below, then choose the correct image key or detail answer.
input.prompt_pt: Leia abaixo as quatro notas curtas de inspiracao e depois escolha a chave correta da imagem ou a resposta correta de detalhe.
input.reference_text_en:
Note 1: This design is inspired by nature and the ocean. The colors are blue, green, and white. I chose a flowy fabric because it looks like water. The mood is calm and soft.

Note 2: This look is inspired by the city. The palette is black, gray, and white. I chose a structured jacket because it looks modern and practical. The contrast makes the look bold.

Note 3: This look is inspired by music. The colors are bright, and the silhouette is loose. I used wide sleeves to show movement. The mood is playful and energetic.

Note 4: This design is inspired by architecture. The jacket has straight lines and structured shoulders. The palette is neutral. The overall look is elegant and strong.
input.reference_text_pt:
Nota 1: This design is inspired by nature and the ocean. The colors are blue, green, and white. I chose a flowy fabric because it looks like water. The mood is calm and soft.

Nota 2: This look is inspired by the city. The palette is black, gray, and white. I chose a structured jacket because it looks modern and practical. The contrast makes the look bold.

Nota 3: This look is inspired by music. The colors are bright, and the silhouette is loose. I used wide sleeves to show movement. The mood is playful and energetic.

Nota 4: This design is inspired by architecture. The jacket has straight lines and structured shoulders. The palette is neutral. The overall look is elegant and strong.
